description: Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail You help our fast-growing mobile app to stay user-centered with meaningful data analysis You create analyses that directly impact product decisions You support product teams with conceptualizing analytics setups You support with A/B test design and analysis and are a key player in promoting a culture of experimentation You act as a fully integrated team member inside the product teams Your profile – this is what we expect from you You have relevant experience of 2-3 years in Product Analytics, working with an app You have a thorough understanding of analytics in a mobile app setting, preferably with Adobe Analytics You have strong communication skills and are capable of aligning different groups of stakeholders – from peers to non-technical business colleagues You have good knowledge of raw data processing (SQL) or Python Any knowledge of any other data, analysis or visualization technology is a plus (e.g. Tableau, MicroStrategy) You are willing to embrace our company culture and enjoy working in an international, English-speaking team What we offer Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin! Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period! Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers: Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances! ‘Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it’s up to you Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment. We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more! Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture! Who we are We are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope The Kaufland App is a multichannel retail and loyalty app that serves different internal business models, including the online marketplace. Its main focus lies on driving the success of Kaufland’s stationary business, while at the same time helping new business models and revenue streams grow. Therefore, we work closely with a large number of departments at Kaufland. Our loyalty program „Kaufland XTRA Card“ is the binding glue between those business models, and the Kaufland App is its most important channel. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!

description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. As Growth Manager, EMEA, you'll drive capital-efficient growth across our EMEA marketplace; owning cross market growth and optimization initiatives end-to-end. This is a highly analytical, cross-functional role: you'll dig into data to find where growth is being left on the table, turn that into tested and scaled solutions, and enjoy the kind of ambiguous, hard-to-crack growth problems that don't come with an existing playbook. Reporting to the Head of EMEA Growth and being part of a 3-person team, you will play a key role finding and closing growth gaps across the region, working closely with the Growth Product, Analytics, and Marketing teams. What you’ll be doing Own goal-setting and efficiency tracking for growth initiatives, using data to find where growth is being left on the table Own growth budget efficiency and ROI — spot what's underperforming and fix it, whether that means reallocating spend, running a new experiment, or changing the process Partner cross-functionally with Growth Product, Analytics, and Marketing to scope, prioritize, and ship both new growth initiatives and improvements to existing ones Drive growth partnerships to success — spot what's not performing, and push the changes that fix it Our humble expectations* Previous experience in consumer or marketplace business, product operations, growth, marketing, or management consulting. Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze and interpret data to inform decisions. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Fluent with AI tools and comfortable weaving them into your everyday workflow. Comfortable moving between deep analytical work and cross-functional collaboration Genuine enjoyment of ambiguous, hard-to-crack growth problems that don't come with an existing playbook Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
title: Consumer Growth Strategy Manager, EMEA

description: Digital an CRM Manager – Leinster Rugby Department: Marketing & Commercial Reports To: Marketing & Brand Lead Location: Dublin Contract Type: Full Time About Leinster Rugby Leinster Rugby is one of Europe’s leading professional rugby organisations, with a proud history, passionate supporter base and ambitions to grow and deepen our relationship with supporters across men’s, women’s and domestic rugby. The Role The CRM & Digital Manager will lead our approach to supporter data, CRM and owned digital channels, creating more connected and personalised fan experiences. This is a new role within Leinster Rugby and a real opportunity to shape how we understand, grow and engage our supporter base. It’s both a strategic and hands-on role, suited to someone who combines strong analytical capability with an understanding of audience behaviour, customer journeys and digital experience. Key Responsibilities CRM Strategy & Audience Growth Support the delivery of fan engagement initiatives across season tickets, matchdays, retail, women’s rugby, grassroots and community programmes Develop and deliver our CRM and audience strategy, growing our known and engaged supporter base. Build audience segments, lifecycle journeys and personalised communications to improve acquisition, engagement, retention and conversion. Plan and deliver CRM activity across email, SMS/WhatsApp and automated journeys, supporting key moments including ticketing, retail, hospitality, women’s and domestic rugby. Test and optimise campaigns, journeys and audiences to continually improve performance. Maintain strong standards of data quality, consent management, governance and compliance Website & App Own the performance and ongoing optimisation of Leinster Rugby’s website and app, with a focus on fan experience, engagement and conversion. Use analytics, audience data, user research and feedback to identify opportunities and inform the digital roadmap. Work with website/app development partners to define, prioritise and deliver UX and functionality improvements. Work with Content, Social and Campaign teams to optimise content journeys, placement and calls to action across owned digital channels. Ensure CRM and audience strategy are connected to the website and app, creating more relevant and personalised supporter journeys. Manage the digital integration and presence of commercial partners across website and app Establish and report against clear digital KPIs, including traffic, engagement, registrations, conversion and other priority supporter actions. Skills & Experience Essential Experience CRM, lifecycle or audience marketing, including email/SMS campaigns and automated customer journeys. Experience with CRM and email marketing platforms, segmentation, automation and testing. Strong analytical skills and experience using data to improve customer journeys and performance Experience using digital analytics to understand website and/or app performance Strong project and stakeholder management skills. The ability to work both strategically and hands-on, with strong attention to detail. Desirable Experience in sport, entertainment, live events or membership organisations would be useful but is not essential. Experience with digital product development, ticketing, UX or digital agencies would also be beneficial. What Success Looks Like Success will mean a growing and more engaged supporter audience; more personalised and automated supporter journeys; stronger website and app performance; better integration between CRM, ticketing and digital channels; and clearer audience insight informing marketing and commercial decision. Why Join Leinster Rugby? This is an opportunity to build and shape a new role, with real ownership of how we understand and engage our supporters. You’ll work across some of our biggest campaigns and matchdays, helping develop our CRM and digital capability and improve the experience we create for supporters.
title: CRM and Digital Marketing Manager

description: About Us At Actioneer, we’re building a voice-first customer engagement platform to help enterprises provide intuitive, consumer-grade experiences for their customers. We work best in customer journeys where there's multiple parties, and complex documents (think insurance purchase, auto-lending, RFIs etc.) We're a small, well-capitalized team backed by investors like South Park Commons, DeVC, Bitkraft and Sony Ventures. We believe everyone is an IC, and we're in a once-in-a-lifetime moment where all of us have the leverage to punch far above our weight. About the role We’re hiring a Growth Marketing Manager focused on starting and scaling the US business. You’ll run campaigns end to end, from the first target list to the qualified opportunity. You’ll own the numbers those campaigns produce. Our deals typically involve several stakeholders and long cycles. Each campaign has to reach more than one person in the account. You’ll work with Sales and Product closely. You’ll pick the channels, write the copy, build the workflows and own the outcome. What you’ll own End to end ownership of marketing across channels (socials, email, events) Qualified opportunities from target accounts each quarter, against a target you help set. Systematic experimentation to isolate specific hooks for each ICP, and build learnings What we’re looking for You’ve grown something from zero. A product, a company or your own audience all count. You were on the team that took a B2B company to $5M ARR or beyond. You’ve driven growth in the US market and know which channels reach US buyers. 4+ years in B2B growth or demand roles, mostly at Seed to Series B companies. You run each campaign as an experiment with a sharp hypothesis and a target metric This role isn’t for you if You’ve only done growth at large companies with an established brand and budget. You mostly manage agencies and don’t build campaigns yourself.
title: Growth Marketing Manager

description: Job Description: Product Owner – Data Platform Location: Bangalore, India Company: Bridgestone Employment Type: Full-Time Role Overview Bridgestone is seeking an experienced Product Owner – Data Platform to drive the strategy, development, and continuous enhancement of data products and platform capabilities that support business decision-making and operational efficiency. The Product Owner will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear product requirements, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes. The role will work closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Architects, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, high-quality data solutions that generate business value. The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership and stakeholder management skills with a solid understanding of modern data platforms, data engineering, analytics, and cloud technologies. The candidate should be comfortable translating business requirements into data use cases, analytical requirements, data models, dashboards, and actionable technical stories. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap Define and maintain the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data platform products in alignment with Bridgestone's business priorities. Identify opportunities to improve business processes, reporting capabilities, data accessibility, and operational efficiency through data-driven solutions. Translate business objectives into product goals, measurable outcomes, and prioritized initiatives. Evaluate and prioritize feature enhancements, platform capabilities, data integration requirements, and technical improvements based on business value, customer impact, risk, and effort. Drive continuous improvement and innovation across data products and platform capabilities. Business Requirement Analysis and Product Backlog Management Engage with business stakeholders to understand business processes, challenges, reporting needs, KPIs, and data requirements. Translate business requirements into epics, features, user stories, use cases, functional specifications, and clear acceptance criteria. Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring requirements are refined and ready for development. Collaborate with Data Analysts to define business metrics, KPIs, reporting requirements, dashboard expectations, and analytical use cases. Work with Data Engineers to translate business requirements into data ingestion, transformation, integration, modeling, and pipeline requirements. Resolve requirement ambiguities, manage dependencies, and ensure alignment between business expectations and technical implementation. Data Platform and Product Delivery Partner with Data Engineering teams to deliver scalable and reliable data pipelines, data transformations, and platform capabilities. Understand the principles of modern data architectures, including Medallion Architecture (Raw, Silver, and Gold layers), data ingestion, transformation, and data modeling. Facilitate discussions on source-to-target mapping, data availability, refresh frequency, dependencies, data lineage, and downstream consumption. Coordinate delivery of data products built using AWS, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, SQL, and related technologies. Work with engineering teams on data integration requirements involving AWS services such as S3, Glue, Aurora/RDS, Lambda, and Step Functions. Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint reviews, release planning, and dependency management. Proactively identify and resolve delivery blockers, scope conflicts, and cross-team dependencies. Collaboration with Data Engineers and Data Analysts Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Data Analysts. Ensure Data Engineers have clear requirements for pipeline development, transformations, data models, validation, reconciliation, and operational workflows. Ensure Data Analysts have a clear understanding of business questions, KPI definitions, data requirements, dashboard specifications, and expected insights. Coordinate the complete flow from business requirement discovery through data ingestion, processing, validation, analytics, and business consumption. Facilitate collaboration between engineering and analytics teams to resolve data discrepancies, quality issues, and inconsistencies in business metrics. Ensure that delivered data products are fit for purpose, documented, validated, and ready for business adoption. Data Quality, Governance, and Reliability Define and prioritize data quality expectations covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and reliability. Partner with Data Engineers and Data Analysts to establish appropriate validation rules, reconciliation processes, quality checks, and monitoring requirements. Ensure data defects are prioritized based on business impact and that root causes and corrective actions are tracked to closure. Collaborate with Architecture, Security, and relevant governance teams on data access, privacy, security, and compliance requirements. Ensure data products meet agreed non-functional requirements, including availability, performance, scalability, and operational support. Drive improvements in data reliability and reduce recurring data quality issues and production incidents. Stakeholder Management and Communication Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and analytics teams. Communicate product roadmaps, priorities, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and release plans transparently. Facilitate requirement workshops, stakeholder discussions, backlog prioritization sessions, and product demonstrations. Manage competing priorities and expectations across multiple stakeholders while maintaining focus on business outcomes. Present complex data and technical concepts in clear business terms to support informed decision-making. Build strong working relationships with business teams and ensure stakeholder feedback is incorporated into product planning. Product Performance and Business Value Define and monitor KPIs to measure product adoption, business impact, data quality, platform reliability, and delivery effectiveness. Evaluate the business value of data initiatives and prioritize work based on measurable outcomes. Gather stakeholder feedback and assess whether delivered data products meet business expectations. Conduct post-release reviews to identify improvement opportunities and incorporate lessons learned into the roadmap. Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual data preparation, accelerate access to insights, and improve operational decision-making. Track benefits realization and communicate measurable outcomes to business stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related role. Experience working with data platforms, data products, business intelligence, analytics, or data engineering teams. Demonstrated experience gathering business requirements and translating them into epics, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria. Strong stakeholder management, communication, requirement analysis, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. Experience working with cross-functional teams comprising Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Architects, QA, and business stakeholders. Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, backlog management, sprint planning, estimation, and iterative product delivery. Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts, with the ability to understand data structures, transformations, and data validation requirements. Understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, data modeling, data quality, and reporting/analytics workflows. Familiarity with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence. Ability to balance business priorities, technical dependencies, platform reliability, and long-term product scalability. Preferred Qualifications Experience owning data platform products or enterprise data and analytics initiatives in a large organization. Familiarity with AWS data services, including S3, Glue, Aurora/RDS, Lambda, and Step Functions. Understanding of Databricks, Spark, PySpark, SQL, Python, and Medallion Architecture. Exposure to data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI, including dashboards, KPI reporting, and business metrics. Understanding of data ingestion, transformation, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and pipeline orchestration. Experience with data modernization, platform migration, integration, and enterprise-scale data initiatives. Familiarity with API-based integrations and third-party data sources. Experience defining data quality rules, governance requirements, data access controls, and operational monitoring expectations. Experience working with distributed teams and stakeholders across different geographies and time zones. Relevant product management, Agile, cloud, or data-related certifications are an advantage

description: About seca seca – Precision for Health is the global market leader in medical measuring and weighing systems. Since 1840, we have been helping healthcare professionals solve complex challenges with simple, innovative solutions that go far beyond measuring height and weight. From integrated measuring stations connected to electronic health records to advanced body composition analysis, seca continues to set new standards in medical technology. As a 100% family-owned company in its fourth generation, we combine tradition and innovation to make a meaningful contribution to healthcare worldwide. The seca Dubai team drives growth across the Middle East and works closely with our international headquarters to further strengthen seca’s market position in the region. About the role We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager (m/f/x) Middle East , based in Dubai. In this role, you will take ownership of hands-on performance marketing and lead generation, with a clear focus on generating qualified leads and supporting sales growth. You will plan, launch and optimize digital campaigns, manage performance through data and work closely with the local Sales team and HQ Marketing. What you’ll do: Lead Generation & Customer Acquisition: Drive qualified lead generation and customer acquisition using HubSpot and targeted digital marketing initiatives. Performance Marketing: Plan, set up, manage and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with a focus on conversions, lead quality and ROI. Campaigns & Local Marketing: Work with Sales and HQ Marketing to localize global campaigns and develop effective multi-channel activities for the Middle East market. Data & Optimization: Monitor KPIs, analyze campaign and customer data and turn insights into concrete optimization measures. Marketing Automation: Use HubSpot for lead management, automation and nurturing and work closely with Sales to turn leads into business opportunities. Events & B2B Marketing: Organize local events, webinars and conferences and support joint marketing activities with B2B customers. What you bring: 5+ years of experience in marketing, ideally with a strong focus on performance marketing and lead generation Hands-on experience setting up, managing and optimizing digital campaigns across paid channels Strong experience with HubSpot or related tool and performance marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and LinkedIn Ads A data-driven mindset and a strong understanding of conversion, campaign performance and ROI Experience working closely with Sales and translating business objectives into effective marketing activities An entrepreneurial, proactive and hands-on approach, combined with strong organizational skills Degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a comparable field, or equivalent professional experience Fluent in English; Arabic is a plus Why seca? 185 years of medical technology – four generations of family ownership – one team shaping the future together. At seca, it’s not just what you do, but who you do it with. That’s why we offer more than the usual perks. Our team values especially: Teams that support each other and collaborate in all situations Flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths that leave room for ideas and fast action Competitive salary, flexible working hours, and a modern, inspiring workspace Join a workplace that connects, motivates, and moves forward together – where your work has real impact. Ready to create impactful social media content in healthcare? Apply today and help shape how seca shows up across global digital platforms.
title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/f/x) Middle East
